name: GetApplicationProvisioningConfig

ApplicationProvisioningConfig.description_en: The account synchronization configuration of the application
ApplicationProvisioningConfig.description_zh: 应用的账户同步功能配置

CallbackProvisioningConfig.description_en: The configuration parameters for the custom event callback protocol of IDaaS
CallbackProvisioningConfig.description_zh: IDaaS自定义事件回调协议配置参数

CallbackUrl.description_en: The destination address where the application receives IDaaS event callbacks
CallbackUrl.description_zh: 应用接受IDaaS事件回调的目标地址

EncryptKey.description_en: The symmetric key for encrypting and decrypting IDaaS event callbacks. This key uses the AES-256 algorithm and is in hexadecimal format
EncryptKey.description_zh: IDaaS事件回调对称加解密密钥，AES256算法类型密钥，Hex编码格式

EncryptRequired.description_en:
Indicates whether to encrypt IDaaS event callback messages. Valid values:

true: The messages are encrypted.

false: The messages are not encrypted and are transmitted in plaintext
EncryptRequired.description_zh:
IDaaS事件回调消息是否加密，取值可选范围：
true：加密。
false：不加密，明文传递

ListenEventScopes.description_en: The list of message types for the IDaaS event callback listener
ListenEventScopes.description_zh: IDaaS事件回调监听消息类型列表

</props>

ConfigOperateMode.description_en:
The rendering mode of the account synchronization page. Valid values:

standard: standard mode.

template: template mode
ConfigOperateMode.description_zh:
账户同步页面渲染方式， 取值可选范围：
standard：标准模式。
template：模版模式
ConfigOperateMode.title_zh: 账户同步页面渲染方式

ProvisionJwksEndpoint.description_en: The public key endpoint for signature verification of application synchronization callback messages
ProvisionJwksEndpoint.description_zh: 应用同步回调信息验签公钥端点
ProvisionJwksEndpoint.title_zh: 应用同步验签公钥端点

ProvisionPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether to synchronize passwords in IDaaS user event callbacks. Valid values:

true: Passwords are synchronized.

false: Passwords are not synchronized
ProvisionPassword.description_zh:
IDaaS用户事件回调是否同步密码，取值可选范围：
true：同步密码。
false：不同步密码
ProvisionPassword.title_zh: 同步信息是否包含密码

ProvisionProtocolType.description_en:
The protocol type for application synchronization. Valid values:

idaas_callback: the custom event callback protocol of IDaaS.

scim2: the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) protocol
ProvisionProtocolType.description_zh:
应用同步协议类型，取值范围可选：
idaas_callback ： IDaaS自定义事件回调协议。
scim2: SCIM协议

ScimProvisioningConfig.description_en: The configuration parameters for IDaaS SCIM protocol synchronization
ScimProvisioningConfig.description_zh: IDaaS SCIM协议同步配置参数

AuthnConfiguration.description_en: The configuration parameters for SCIM protocol synchronization
AuthnConfiguration.description_zh: SCIM协议同步相关配置参数

AuthnMode.description_en:
The authorization mode for the SCIM protocol interface. Valid values:

oauth2: OAuth2 mode
AuthnMode.description_zh:
SCIM协议接口授权模式。取值可选范围：
oauth2：OAuth2模式

AuthnParam.description_en:
The authorization configuration parameters. Usage:

If GrantType is set to client_credentials, you must specify ClientId, ClientSecret, and AuthnMethod.

If GrantType is set to bearer_token, you must specify AccessToken
AuthnParam.description_zh:
授权相关配置参数。使用方式如下：
当GrantType为client_credentials时， 需要填写ClientId, ClientSecret, AuthnMethod。
当GrantType为bearer_token时，需要填写AccessToken

AccessToken.description_en: The access token. This parameter is required when GrantType is set to bearer_token
AccessToken.description_zh: 访问令牌。bearer_token密钥模式时需要填写该字段

AuthnMethod.description_en:
The authentication mode for the SCIM protocol. Valid values:

client_secret_basic: The key is passed in the request header.

client_secret_post: The key is passed in the request body
AuthnMethod.description_zh:
SCIM协议认证模式， 取值可选范围：
client_secret_basic： 通过请求Header传递密钥。
client_secret_post：通过请求body传递密钥

ClientId.description_en: The client ID of the application

ClientSecret.description_en: The client secret of the application

GrantType.description_en:
The authorization mode for the SCIM protocol. Valid values:

client_credentials: client credentials mode.

bearer_token: bearer token mode
GrantType.description_zh:
SCIM协议授权模式。取值可选范围：
client_credentials：客户端模式。
bearer_token：密钥模式

FullPushScopes.description_en:
The scope of a full push for the SCIM protocol. Valid values:

urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:PUSH: performs a full synchronization of users
FullPushScopes.description_zh:
SCIM协议全量推送范围。取值可选范围：
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:PUSH 用户全量同步

items.description_en: The scope of a full push for the SCIM protocol

ProvisioningActions.description_en:
The operations on the target resource for the SCIM protocol. Valid values:

urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:CREATE: creates an account.

urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:UPDATE: updates an account.

urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:DELETE: deletes an account
ProvisioningActions.description_zh:
SCIM协议目标资源操作行为。取值可选范围：
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:CREATE 账户创建
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:UPDATE 账户更新
urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:DELETE 账户删除

items.description_en: The operation on the target resource for the SCIM protocol
items.description_zh: SCIM协议目标资源操作行为

ScimBaseUrl.description_en: The base URL where the application receives IDaaS SCIM protocol synchronization
ScimBaseUrl.description_zh: 应用接受IDaaS同步SCIM协议的Base地址

Status.description_en:
The status of the IDaaS account synchronization feature. Valid values:

enabled: The feature is enabled.

disabled: The feature is disabled
Status.description_zh:
IDaaS账户同步功能启用状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：启用中。
disabled：禁用中
Status.title_zh: IDaaS 应用同步启用状态
